name: Dinosaur Bone #30

name: Rock Carving #1
description: This carving is located at the end of the road on Mount Hagen.

name: Rock Carving #2
description: You'll find this carving facing the river.

name: Rock Carving #3
description: To find this carving, start by approaching the mountains from the southern side of the river. Once you climb to the top, you'll see a passage leading down between the trees. The carving will be near the top, facing the river.

name: Rock Carving #4
description:
To find this carving, walk to the edge of the mountain and follow the small mountain pass leading down.
Another way is to jump down from the top of the mountain seen in the screenshot.

name: Rock Carving #5
description: You'll see this carving from the western side of Owanjila Lake.

name: Rock Carving #6
description: This carving can be found by walking to the edge of the mountain and following a path that leads down to a giant skeleton. Walk around the corner to see the carving facing the valley below the mountain.

name: Rock Carving #7
description: You'll find this carving near the very top of a cliff.

name: Rock Carving #8
description: Just south of Moonstone Pond, you'll find a rock on the plateau with a pyramid carving on it.

name: Rock Carving #9
description: This carving is facing the road.

name: Rock Carving #10
description: This carving can be found east of the Elysian Pool, by the road.

name: Abandoned Trading Post
description: Lift up one of the floor planks to reveal a hidden stash.

name: Barrel Rider
description: A thrill seeker went over Donner Falls in a barrel. It ended exactly how you'd expect.

name: Bolger Glade
description: Approach the cannons in the middle of the battlefield to add this POI to your journal.

name: Braithwaites' Secret
description: A physically deformed and mentally ill woman can be found locked inside this outhouse.
tips: She's still there in the epilogue.

name: Brush Fire
description: Can be added to your journal by standing near the burnt wagon nearby.

name: Circus Wagons
description: A fortune telling machine can be found inside the blue wagon.

name: Coal Mine Writing
description: At the bottom of the Annesburg coal mine, in the northwesternmost tunnel, carved into the wooden wall. It is added to the player's journal without comment, and serves as the unofficial start to the Reed Cottage Treasure.
tips:
North Bennet Flew

North Bennett Flue

Red Roof, Green Door

Brothers I’ll be poor no more.

This clue is intended to lead the player to Reed Cottage, north of Annesburg, wherein the player should check the chimney to find the Sketched Treasure Map.

name: Crashed Airship
description: The wreckage of a flying machine with a corpse inside.
tips:
This may be an Easter Egg referencing the Kinnear family from Red Dead Redemption 1. Charles Kinnear creates an ill-fated flying machine in the 'Deadalus and Son' side mission, and another of his machines can be found in this game when exploring New Austin.

The wreck here _could_ be the work of Charles' brother Percival, as the corpse wears remarkably similar glasses to Charles.

name: Devil's Cave
description: NB: You may need to enter and leave the cave to inspect it, where it will be added to your journal under the name 'Hidden Tunnel'.

name: Donkey Lady
description: Inspect the corpse of a woman with a donkey skull tied to the wheel.
tips:
This is a reference to a glitch in the first Red Dead Redemption, where the game would spawn an NPC with the behaviour and face of a donkey.

The glitch became popular after YouTube channel WhereDaBootz made a video showcasing the glitch.

name: Face in Cliff
description: A Mount Rushmore-esque face carved into the mountain. Approach from the north to make it to the top.
tips: The sculptor has died by suicide and left a note which you can retrieve from his body - "Note from the Sculptor"

name: Flying Machine
description: The wreckage of a flying machine, with "Charles Kinnear" written on the back.
tips: This references a character of the same name from the first Red Dead Redemption, who creates an ill-fated flying machine in the 'Deadalus and Son' side mission. The wreck here is likely to be the work of a younger Charles, who clearly did not improve his craft with age.

name: Fossilized Man
description: On a rock ledge, near the tunnel entrance

name: Frozen Settler
description: Wearing the Morion Helmet.

name: Giant Remains
description: Follow the path south-east.  The skeleton is under a large overhanging rock, and above a rock carving.

name: Gray's Secret
description: On a porch. Only appears after completing the Chapter 3 mission "A Short Walk in a Pretty Town"

name: Hermit Woman
description: A solitary woman living alone with several feral dogs. Some theorize that she moved to this location to become a witch.

name: Jesuit Missionary
description: On his body you'll find the Letter to Brother Rodolfo.

name: Manmade Mutant
description: A gruesome frankenstein experiment, made from various animal parts.
tips: Enter the building by climbing through the window on the second floor, above the southwest porch.

name: Meditating Monk
description: Seems to only appear at noon.

name: Meteor House
description: This cabin has a hole in the roof where a meteorite has come through and killed the inhabitants.  The room is smoking and the bodies are burned.  Inside you can collect the meteorite.

name: Mysterious Aztec Writing #1
description: Location: Left hand side of the blue building on a wood pole in the water

name: Mysterious Aztec Writing #2
description: Location: On top of the mortuary

name: Mysterious Aztec Writing #3
description: Location: On the wall in the alley.

name: Mysterious Aztec Writing #4
description: Location: In the alley behind the general store - on the wall

name: Mysterious Aztec Writing #5
description: Location: In the alleyway, on the wall

name: Mysterious Aztec Writing #6
description: Location: On the roof.

name: Native Burial Site
description:
A Stone Hatchet can be found in the centre of its large stone circle.
If you start a fire in the center of the stone circle, it will start to rain.

name: Obelisk
description: A 3-sided stone obelisk mounted on a square stone. On the west side, a plaque is located that contains the date 1771 and the latin phrase, "Hora fugit, ne tardes" which translates to "The hour flees, don't be late", a popular motto often used on sun dials.
tips: Pull the plaque off and you'll find a gold earring and another treasure map.

name: Oil Derrick
description: A letter from the vice president of Cornwall Kerosene & Tar can be found on the body by the Derrick, while Dinosaur Bone #3 is inside it.
tips: Ginseng Elixir can be found in the abandoned camp.

name: Old Tomb
description: Home to a Viking Hatchet, Viking Helmet, and Ancient Viking Comb.

name: Old World Scripts
description: Engraved on the boulder on top of the ledge. Roughly translates to:
tips: _We Arrived By Boat Beautiful Land Gracious People We Left Them To Live In Peace_

name: Pagan Ritual
description: Home to the Pagan Skull Mask and a bottle of Valerian Root.

name: Painting in Cabin
description: Finished painting can only be seen in the epilogue.
tips: Note: It was previously believed that you needed 100% completion to inspect this location but this is not the case.

name: Phonograph
description: Inside the houseboat

name: Register Rock
description: Just off the trail (to the north) and to the left of the tree. A "register rock" is one with names carved into it. You can see some from the trail, but most are on the topside of the large rock.

name: Serpent Mound
description: Climb up the watchtower to inspect the site.

name: Strange Statues - Painting
description: This area has a big rock formation with a hole in the middle of it.  Head into the circular opening in the big rock to inspect a painting.
tips: Before or after discovering this painting, you can visit the Strange Statues Cave and solve its puzzle to earn three gold bars (which fetch a price of $500 each.)

name: Strange Statues Cave
description: Puzzle: Each statue has a certain number of fingers. You need to push the buttons on the statues that have the number of fingers: 2, 3, 5 and 7 (prime numbers).
tips:
One of the statues is missing an arm, which can be found in a pile of rocks in the corner of the cave. This statue will represent 7. If you accidentally press a button on an incorrect statue, you can push the button back out by pressing a button on the back of the statue. The order that you select does not matter. It's hard to see this button, so use Eagle Eye and first person view.

Reward: Gold Bar x3 (worth $1500 total!)

name: Tiny Church
description: A tiny church for a tiny congregation

name: Trail Trees (I)
description: On the right side of the road before the bridge.

name: Warped Tree
description: At the top of a hill, next to a grave.

name: Whale Bones
description: A set of whale bones found in Big Valley, West Elizabeth. You can find this site West of Owanjila, on a hill that overlooks the lake.
